title: Scenario expectation (scenarios/<name>/expected.yaml)
description: What Shadewright is expected to conclude for one scenario, and for each part whether it has been observed or is planned. Checked with kubeconform against this file (scripts/scenario.sh check). Documented in scenarios/README.md.

name.description: The scenario's folder name, also the make target: make scenario-<name>.

render.description: Whether apps/ with this scenario applied passes the render check. Only a scenario that breaks the render on purpose (invalid manifest) says fails; the harness refuses a scenario whose render does not match.

reason.description: The reason the Incident must carry: an event reason (FailedScheduling, Failed, BackOff) or a container termination reason (OOMKilled). The collector reads Warning events and terminations only, never waiting reasons such as ImagePullBackOff or CreateContainerConfigError.

object.description: The object the incident is about.

status.description: observed: seen in a lab or Kind run (say which in source). planned: expected from the code or the cluster component's behaviour, not seen yet.

source.description: Where the reason comes from: the component that emits the event or termination, and the collector path that reads it.

evidence.description: Facts the diagnosis must name, each with the source it is read from.

fact.description: A short phrase: the image reference, the missing Secret's name, the restart count.

source.description: Where the fact is read from: an event, a container status, a Flux or KEDA condition, a Prometheus query, a file in Git.

status.description: observed: the analysis named these facts in a run. planned: no analysis has produced them yet (the diagnosis step is not built).

oneOf.description: Shadewright opens a pull request with one catalog action.

action.description: The catalog action type, such as SetContainerMemoryLimit or AdjustKedaMaxReplicas.

bounds.description: The range the proposed value must fall in, as quantities (64Mi) or integers.

paths.description: The only files the pull request may change.

status.description: observed: this outcome was seen in a run. planned: it is what the design requires, not seen yet.

note.description: What was observed, with a link, when status is observed.

oneOf.description: Shadewright proposes nothing and a person is notified.

reason.description: Why no change may be proposed.

phase.description: The phase a RemediationRequest ends in, if one is created at all.

status.description: observed: this outcome was seen in a run. planned: it is what the design requires, not seen yet.

note.description: What was observed, with a link, when status is observed.
